channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-windows
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: WinGlide — via awesome-windows
item.description: Navigate windows by taskbar position (not Z-order like Alt+Tab) and jump between virtual desktops with keyboard shortcuts.

item.title: YAKC — via awesome-windows
item.description: Keystroke and mouse-click visualizer for screencasts, streaming and presentations.

item.title: TaskSlinger — via awesome-windows
item.description: A fast, native Windows Task Manager replacement with process monitoring, performance graphs, services, startup apps, and network connections.

item.title: OpenHabitTracker — via awesome-windows
item.description: Take notes, plan tasks, and track habits.

item.title: MoonProxy — via awesome-windows
item.description: An open-source cross-platform FRP desktop GUI client for macOS and Windows.

item.title: Highlight Vault — via awesome-windows
item.description: Free Windows app that imports Kindle/Kobo highlights into a searchable local library, with export and an optional paid Pro upgrade.

item.title: FrameShift — via awesome-windows
item.description: Windows media utility for right-click workflows: convert, compress, crop, cut and edit video, audio and images with local AI features including background removal, image upscaling, audio stem separation (Demucs), denoising (DeepFilterNet) and RIFE interpolation.

item.title: FluxDown — via awesome-windows
item.description: Multi-protocol download manager with IDM-style dynamic segmentation for HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent and HLS/DASH streams.

item.title: PotPlayer — via awesome-windows
item.description: Media player with hardware acceleration and streaming capabilities.

item.title: iScribby — via awesome-windows
item.description: A neat little tool that allows you to draw and copy things directly on your screen from anywhere, without interrupting your workflow.

item.title: Talkdedsec Visual — via awesome-windows
item.description: Adjusts screen brightness, contrast, gamma and colour temperature in real time.

item.title: GPU Shark — via awesome-windows
item.description: GPU Shark - Lightweight native NVIDIA GPU telemetry monitor for Windows.
